title: rosa suffulta f. alba
intro: Rosa suffulta f. alba, commonly known as the fragrant white rose of Shropshire, is a species of rose that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rosa suffulta f. alba include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids.
